title: Converge
summary: CONVERGE, verb intransitive [Latin , to incline. See Verge.] To tend to one point; to incline and approach nearer together, as two lines which continually approach each other; opposed to diverge. Line

inlines.v: CONVERGE, verb intransitive [Latin , to incline. See Verge.] To tend to one point; to incline and approach nearer together, as two lines which continually approach each other; opposed to diverge. Lines which converge in one direction, diverge in the other. The mountains converge into a single ridge.
